def _cat_key(series: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    """Normalize a raw categorical field to stable string tokens.

    Lowercased/stripped; NaN, empty and literal 'nan'/'none' map to MISSING_TOKEN
    so 'not answered' becomes a real fitted category instead of an aliased value.
    """
    s = series.astype(object).where(~series.isna(), MISSING_TOKEN)
    s = s.astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    s = s.where(~s.isin(["", "nan", "none", "null"]), MISSING_TOKEN)
    return s

I've implemented the plan with these changes:

- **`CAT_FIELDS`, `MISSING_INDICATOR_COLS`, `MISSING_TOKEN`** constants added after `FREQ_COLS`.
- **`_cat_key`** helper normalizes tokens (lowercase/strip; NaN/empty/null variants → `__missing__`).
- **`categorical_cols`** now equals `CAT_FIELDS` (all 21 discrete fields).
- **`fit`** builds vocabularies from normalized tokens on TRAIN rows only.
- **`transform`** emits `<col>_missing` binary indicators for the five frequency fields + temperature, and emits `<col>_le` for every discrete field using normalized tokens with `.fillna(-1)` so unseen predict-time tokens map to the reserved unknown index while `__missing__` is a real fitted category.
- **`_save_bundle`** asserts `len(cards) == len(cat_cols)`.
- **`run_training_evaluation`** adds a fresh-reload smoke check proving the persisted pipeline reloads verbatim, unseen categories map through `-1 → 0`, and ensembling works without refitting.

Model design required no changes: `split_feature_columns` keys off `CAT_SUFFIX='_le'`, so all new `_le` columns are automatically embedded (cardinalities from the same `_shift_cat` +1 convention; unknown slot guaranteed), preserving the existing optimizer no-decay rule, `emb_dropout=0.05`, `N(0,0.05)` init, hidden dims, residual blocks, and training recipe (seed 42, 5-fold StratifiedKFold, label_smoothing 0.03, AdamW 3e-3/1e-4, OneCycleLR, batch 256, 20 epochs, 3-seed ensemble).
